eyebrow: The pattern that breaks at scale
code:
Loop over Opportunities
  Get Records: related Account
  Update Records: that Account
End Loop

→ 200 queries + 200 writes
caption: A Get Records or Update Records element inside a loop re-runs once per record, not once per batch.

eyebrow: Bulkified — DML moved outside the loop
code:
Loop: collect Account Ids
Get Records: all Accounts in set   (1 query)
Loop: update values in memory
Update Records: whole collection (1 write)
caption: Same 200 records, same outcome — one query and one write instead of 200 of each.
